description: T-5123 (T-2851's plain-range shapes; the column twin of plain-range-delete-rows-across-edge, SPEC-0039 E3's hand rule): one delete_column of B:D (count 3) on a plain range, no table: S!A4:J4 hold 1..10. Sheet F holds A1 =SUM(S!C4:F4) (its first two columns go: does it shrink to S!B4:C4?), A2 FORMULATEXT(A1), A3 the same absolute, A4 FORMULATEXT(A3), A5 =SUM(S!A4:C4) (its last two columns go), A6 FORMULATEXT(A5), A7 =SUM(S!B4:D4) (wholly deleted), A8 FORMULATEXT(A7), A9 =S!J4, A10 FORMULATEXT(A9).
